description:
# 🐛 Bug-fix PR

## 📌 Summary

Fix the team selector dropdown

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8358ad9d-66bc-4b1f-b49e-fd6c8509e585

Closes #3426

## 🔁 Reproduction Steps
1. Load the Admin UI
2. Click the teams dropdown

## 🐞 Root Cause
`window.loadTeamSelectorDropdown` was assigned at line ~33232, near the very end of `admin.js`. The global error handler (`window.addEventListener("error", ...)`) is registered at line `16758`. If any runtime error occurs in `admin.js` between those two points, execution halts and `window.loadTeamSelectorDropdown` is never set. When Alpine then calls `loadTeams()` (after user interaction or some init path), it throws because the function is undefined: caught and re-logged by the already-registered error handler as "Global error".

## 💡 Fix Description
Moved the `loadTeamSelectorDropdown` function and its window registration from line ~33189–33232 to just before the global error handler section.

reviews.author: vishu-bh
reviews.body:
LGTM 👍 
Targeted fix that directly addresses the root cause (registration-order failure), does not expand attack surface, and doesn’t change behavior beyond making loadTeamSelectorDropdown reliably available earlier in script execution.

reviews.author: crivetimihai
reviews.body:
LGTM — clean, minimal, correct fix.

**What was reviewed:**
- Verified the 53 added and 53 removed lines are character-for-character identical — pure code relocation, no functional change.
- Root cause analysis is sound: moving `loadTeamSelectorDropdown()` + its `window.*` assignment before the global error handlers (~line 16807) eliminates ~17,000 lines where a runtime error could prevent the function from being registered.
- No security concerns — no new code, existing `credentials: "same-origin"` fetch pattern preserved.
- No performance impact — pure reordering.
- Logic is correct: guard against missing container and double-loads, proxy-aware `ROOT_PATH`, HTMX processing, error handling with retry UX all intact.
- Pattern consistency: the inline `window.*` assignment style was already used for this function before the move.

**Minor note (not blocking):** The retry handler calls `searchTeamSelector("")` (defined at ~line 33098). If a runtime error halts execution after line 16805 but before 33098, the retry click would throw — but the global error handler catches it, and this is an edge case of an edge case.

Rebased cleanly onto main.
